ui.budget_help: Each real-time folder keeps its own IMAP connection open to wait for new mail; all scheduled folders of a mailbox share one. Mail providers limit how many connections one account may open at once and may reject logins or temporarily restrict the account beyond that, so Mailwake caps connections per mailbox and keeps 1 for folder scans and connection tests. The cap protects your account from provider limits; it is not about saving server resources. If you have many real-time folders, switch less urgent ones to scheduled checks, or raise the limit in mailbox settings (2–100) if your provider allows more connections.
